name: Niw Skills
description:
Open-source plugin for U.S. EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) case work. Honest pre-filing legal evaluation of self-petitions under the current USCIS adjudication standard, with the preponderance-of-the-evidence burden applied prong by prong under Matter of Dhanasar. Built for three cohorts: DIY self-petitioners ready to file, prospective applicants 6–24 months out, and master's/PhD students 3–5 years out who want a multi-year roadmap before committing.

Key features:

• Agentic 5-stage conversation — orient → co-design your proposed endeavor → confirm → full evaluation → follow-ups. Adapts to what you know and what you've provided; produces a clean structured memo, not an engineering trace.
• Citation discipline — every legal rule cites authority inline (Dhanasar, Chawathe, Katigbak, USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 6 Pt. F Ch. 5, and curated AAO decisions).
• Verdict floor under preponderance — no inflated assessments. No prong is rated "Strong" without documented evidence clearing preponderance.
• Hard anti-hallucination rules — no invented citation counts, grant roles, employer facts, or AAO decision IDs.
• Achievable case ceiling — beyond the current-state verdict, the plugin produces a roadmap of concrete prerequisite actions and an honest 0–60 month timeline to reach a stronger case.
• AC21 framing for India/China nationals — surfaces the practical reason most backlogged-country petitioners file NIW: an approved I-140 unlocks indefinite H-1B extension under AC21 § 104(c) and § 106(a).
• Written for international, ESL-primary, highly-educated users — short sentences, technical terms explained on first use, citations in standard form, no idioms.

Future skills shipping in this plugin: endeavor-statement drafter, petition-letter drafter, evidence finder, recommendation-letter drafter, RFE/NOID analyzer.

Not legal advice. Not a substitute for licensed immigration counsel. See DISCLAIMER.md.
